notes.title: Our new game - Estiman - now on Greenlight
notes.content:
Stop clocking for a few second - we've got something new! Once again we're turning something so omnipresent and intuitive you'd never even stop to give it thought into an engaging and original game concept. Our upcoming title - Estiman - is an arcade visual puzzle game of reflexes and wits that engages the player in its mesmerizing flow one exciting combo after another.

The game is almost ready for distribution, and we need YOUR VOTE on our Steam Greenlight page, so we can bring it to you in November at our favorite $1 / 1€ price point.

Estiman is: 

A unique, endless game of reflexes and wits with original estimation-based gameplay 
A dopamine booster with satisfying combos a skilled player can keep going forever 
A minimal audio-visual experience that evolves as you play 
A fantastic selection of game-altering modes and settings 
A limitless gameplay that pleasantly flows and keeps you hooked

Drop by the Estiman Greenlight profile, and tell us what what you think!

notes.title: Update! Fixes! Sausages!
notes.content:
Thanks to user DejaVu, we fixed achievements on mode with 5 chances. Also menu is more responsive to give you a better feeling.

Steam trading cards are on the way, so stay focused and keep clocking!
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25717702/ef92434a743048b1c4cc99d5010a135ff68ffda7.png
